en.title: Infracost
en.desc: The Infracost plugin provides a graphical representation of your infrastructure's cost estimates within Backstage, displaying both a summary of all resources used and a detailed breakdown of the cost components for each resource. It integrates with Terraform-provisioned infrastructure and the Infracost API to give teams visibility into cloud spending directly from their catalog entities.

en.title: Github Workflows
en.desc: The Github Workflows plugin enables manual triggering and monitoring of GitHub Actions workflows directly from Backstage components. It provides workflow listings, real-time status updates, execution logs, and support for workflows with input parameters.

en.title: Kong Service Manager
en.desc: A Backstage frontend plugin that lets you manage Kong Gateway services, routes, and plugins directly from your software catalog. From the entity page, you can view service details, configure plugins, and create or edit routes without leaving Backstage.

en.title: Gitlab Pipelines
en.desc: The Gitlab-pipelines plugin integrates GitLab CI/CD into your Backstage component, allowing you to view pipeline status, trigger or cancel pipelines, and run individual jobs directly from the Backstage UI.

en.title: LDAP Auth
en.desc: Provides a custom LDAP authentication login page for Backstage, replacing the default sign-in page with a Material-UI form that handles credential validation, token management, and session persistence. Users can sign in to their Backstage instance using their LDAP username and password.

en.title: About
en.desc: Displays system information on the VeeCode DevPortal "About" page, including OS, Node.js version, resource utilization, and Backstage/DevPortal versions.

en.title: Kubernetes GPT Analyzer
en.desc: The Kubernetes GPT Analyzer plugin uses AI to analyze your Kubernetes components for errors, listing issues along with AI-generated suggestions and solutions. It integrates with the Backstage Kubernetes plugin and k8sgpt-operator to provide automated, periodic error analysis directly within your Backstage catalog.
